finding: Caesarean section and general anaesthesia are associated with higher neonatal bilirubin levels in the first 8 days of life.
mod_finding: Neonates delivered by caesarean section with general anaesthesia had significantly higher bilirubin levels than those born by caesarean section with spinal anaesthesia, and both groups had higher levels than neonates born by vaginal delivery without anaesthesia; oxytocin use during vaginal delivery was also associated with higher bilirubin levels
